Radio Farda FAQ

What frequency is Radio Farda on?
In the A-26 season Radio Farda is scheduled on 19 shortwave frequencies, including 5860, 7435, 7460, 7470, 7480, 7495 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 9320 kHz (10 am – 8 pm Eastern). For Europe: 9320 kHz (3 pm – 1 am UTC+1).

Can I hear Radio Farda in the USA?
It isn't beamed at North America this season, so hearing it in the USA is a DX catch. Your best chance is 9320 kHz (10 am – 8 pm Eastern) when that band is open, or listen through an online receiver (KiwiSDR/WebSDR) closer to its target area.

Does Radio Farda broadcast in English on shortwave?
Not this season. Radio Farda is scheduled in Farsi.

Is Radio Farda on the air right now?
As of Friday, October 9, 2026, 11:53 UTC, Radio Farda is scheduled to be broadcasting on 5860 kHz to Iran. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
